nodes.title: Selected spec entry summary renderer
nodes.body: Render the selected spec identity plus the accepted intent summary before offering the next move.

nodes.title: Help a user orient inside one workspace
nodes.body: The selected workspace and spec should be legible before the session asks for deeper work.

nodes.title: Show the selected spec before deeper work begins
nodes.body: On cold start or resume, the session must surface the selected spec identity before proposing downstream work.

nodes.title: Selected spec entry proof
nodes.body: Verify the selected spec identity and accepted intent summary appear before downstream prompts.

nodes.title: FE-1175 Selected Spec Entry Delivery
nodes.body: Delivery frontier for the selected-spec entry feature. Groups all execution-ready scopes that satisfy the spec entry orientation requirement.

nodes.title: Selected Spec Entry — Handoff Scope
nodes.body: Executor-ready scope. Implement the selected-spec entry summary renderer (MOD1) to satisfy the requirement to show the selected spec before deeper work begins (REQ1). Exit when the selected spec entry proof check (CH1) passes.

edges.rationale: The user-facing requirement is the concrete behavior that establishes the orientation goal.
The renderer materializes the accepted requirement.
The execution handoff should depend on a proof that the selected-spec entry behavior is present.
The scope is a constituent delivery unit under the FE-1175 frontier.
The scope directly realizes REQ1 — showing the selected spec before deeper work begins.
MOD1 (the renderer) is a constituent part of this scope's implementation surface.
The scope depends on CH1 as its exit criterion; it is not done until CH1 passes.
